svg.aria-label: Station Spray Booth, rust-preventive oil: inside the booth the roller line from QC Gate 2 turns the corner and runs out towards Junbiki. The OK block stops under the spray portal, where five nozzles mist rust-preventive oil onto its top, both long sides and both ends. The pump behind the line feeds the nozzles from the oil tank under the rollers, which catches the overspray.
